category: Fixed Home Appliances/Electronics Requiring Mains Power
explanation: Refrigerator, Oven, Washing Machine, and Television are all typically large, fixed home appliances or entertainment systems that require a continuous connection to mains electricity for operation. A Smartphone is primarily a portable, battery-powered device, even though it recharges from an outlet.
